shares.documentation:
BEst (Bloomberg Estimates) FFOPS reflects the consensus estimate for Funds From Operations Per Share (FFOPS). The consensus estimate is the mean of sell-side analyst estimates.

Note:
Available for Broker estimates and Consensus: Standard, 28 Days, Post Event, and Custom. Definition may differ based on certain industry or region specifications. The period can be shifted forward or backward by providing an offset to BEst Fiscal Period Override (BE997, BEST_FPERIOD_OVERRIDE) (3FQ, -2FY, etc.).

shares.description: BEst Dividend Per Share Broker Estimates
shares.documentation:
Matrix of the latest broker estimates for the dividend per share (DPS) for the security.  The DPS may be presented on a Net or Gross basis, depending on the country's specific treatment of dividends.  The field returns the Broker, Analyst, Date of the Estimate, Current Period Estimate, Current Period Change, Next Period Estimate, Next Period Change.  The criteria each estimate is based on may vary by analyst.  This field may be overridden by the following fields:
   BEst Consolidated Override (BE999, BEST_CONSOLIDATED_OVERRIDE),
   BEst Fiscal Period Override (BE997, BEST_FPERIOD_OVERRIDE), and
   Equity Fundamental Currency (DS215, EQY_FUND_CRNCY).

shares.description: BEst Book Value Per Share Broker Estimates
shares.documentation:
Matrix of the latest broker estimates for the book value per share (BPS) for the security.  BPS is calculated as:

(Share Capital + Additional Paid in Capital + Retained Earnings) / Balance Sheet Shares Outstanding.

The field returns the Broker, Analyst, Date of the Estimate, Current Period Estimate, Current Period Change, Next Period Estimate, Next Period Change.  The criteria each estimate is based on may vary by analyst.  This field may be overridden by the following fields:
   BEst Consolidated Override (BE999, BEST_CONSOLIDATED_OVERRIDE),
   BEst Fiscal Period Override (BE997, BEST_FPERIOD_OVERRIDE), and
   Equity Fundamental Currency (DS215, EQY_FUND_CRNCY).

shares.description: BEst Cashflow Per Share Broker Estimates
shares.documentation:
Matrix of the latest broker estimates for the cash flow per share (CPS) for the security.  The CPS estimate is calculated as:

(Net Income + Depreciation and Amortization + Other Non-Cash Adjustments + Change in No-Cash Working Capital)/ Basic Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding for the period.

The field returns the Broker, Analyst, Date of the Estimate, Current Period Estimate, Current Period Change, Next Period Estimate, Next Period Change.  The criteria each estimate is based on may vary by analyst.  This field may be overridden by the following fields:
   BEst Consolidated Override (BE999, BEST_CONSOLIDATED_OVERRIDE),
   BEst Fiscal Period Override (BE997, BEST_FPERIOD_OVERRIDE), and
   Equity Fundamental Currency (DS215, EQY_FUND_CRNCY).

shares.description: BEst Funds from Ops Per Share Broker Estimates
shares.documentation:
Matrix of the latest broker estimates for the funds from operations per share (FFOPS) for the security.  The FFOPS is calculated as:

(Net Income - Preferred Dividends + Depreciation on Real Estate Income Producing Assets + Gains(Losses) from Property Sales + Non-Recurring Gains(Charges), excluding impairment of real estate assets + Debt Restructuring) / Basic Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding.

The field returns the Broker, Analyst, Date of the Estimate, Current Period Estimate, Current Period Change, Next Period Estimate, Next Period Change.  The criteria each estimate is based on may vary by analyst.  This field may be overridden by the following fields:
   BEst Consolidated Override (BE999, BEST_CONSOLIDATED_OVERRIDE),
   BEst Fiscal Period Override (BE997, BEST_FPERIOD_OVERRIDE), and
   Equity Fundamental Currency (DS215, EQY_FUND_CRNCY).

shares.description: BEst AFFO Per Share Broker Estimates
shares.documentation:
Matrix of the latest broker estimates for Funds From Operations Per Share (FFOPS) less capital expenditures and other adjustments. The field returns the Broker, Analyst, Date of the Estimate, Current Period Estimate, Current Period Change, Next Period Estimate, and Next Period Change. The criteria each estimate is based on may vary by analyst. This field may be overridden by the following fields:

BEst Consolidated Override (BE999, BEST_CONSOLIDATED_OVERRIDE),
BEst Fiscal Period Override (BE997, BEST_FPERIOD_OVERRIDE), and
Equity Fundamental Currency (DS215, EQY_FUND_CRNCY).

compensation.description: BEst EPS Excludes Stock Based Compensation
compensation.documentation:
Indicates the company excludes stock compensation expense from their comparable Adjusted Earnings Per Share.

If the return is 'Y', Estimate Comparable EPS Excluding Stock Based Compensation (IS907, IS_COMP_EPS_EXCL_STOCK_COMP) is used to compare Bloomberg's Adjusted EPS consensus estimate (BE008, BEST_EPS) and Adjusted Guidance EPS forecast (BE206, CEST_EPS) data.

If the return is 'N', Estimate Comparable Including Stock Based Compensation (IS900, IS_COMP_EPS_ADJUSTED) is used to compare to Bloomberg's Adjusted EPS consensus estimate (BE008) and Adjusted Guidance EPS forecast (BE206) data.

amortization.documentation: BEst (Bloomberg Estimates) estimate of a company's amortization expense from intangible assets.

GAAP net.documentation: The BEst GAAP Net Income estimate is defined as the 'bottom line' or 'reported' profit. It always includes non-recurring (or one-time) items. However, it may include or exclude extraordinary items. Available for Broker  estimates and Consensus: Standard, Re-Set  Consensus, and 4 Week.
The number of GAAP Net Income estimates for the specified estimate period. Available for Consensus only: Standard, Re-Set and 4 week

GAAP net.description: BEst Net Income GAAP Broker Estimates
GAAP net.documentation:
Matrix of the latest broker estimates for the net income GAAP (generally accepted accounting principles) for the security.  Net income is defined as the profit after all expenses have been deducted.  The field returns the Broker, Analyst, Date of the Estimate, Current Period Estimate, Current Period Change, Next Period Estimate, Next Period Change.  The criteria each estimate is based on may vary by analyst.  This field may be overridden by the following fields:
   BEst Consolidated Override (BE999, BEST_CONSOLIDATED_OVERRIDE),
   BEst Fiscal Period Override (BE997, BEST_FPERIOD_OVERRIDE), and
   Equity Fundamental Currency (DS215, EQY_FUND_CRNCY).
The median estimated GAAP Net Income for the specified estimate period Available for Consensus only: Standard, Re-Set and 4 week
The analysts' high GAAP Net Income estimate for the specified estimate period. Available for Consensus only: Standard, Re-Set and 4 week
The analysts' low GAAP Net Income estimate for the specified estimate period. Available for Consensus only: Standard, Re-Set and 4 week

A statistical measure of the dispersion of the contributed GAAP Net Income estimates around their mean value expressed in the same units as the data. The standard deviation of a consensus expresses the level of agreement amongst the contributed data. A consensus with a high standard deviation would represent more dissent while a lower standard deviation would represent concurrence. Available for Consensus only: Standard, Re-Set and 4 week
The change in the specified period  GAAP Net Income estimate within the four weeks prior to today's date. Not a percent change.  Available for Consensus only: Standard, Re-Set and 4 week

GAAP net.description: Best Net Income GAAP 3 Month % Change
GAAP net.documentation: Percent change in the specified period GAAP net income estimate over the last three months. Available for Standard, Re-Set and 4 Week consensus only.

GAAP net.description: BEst Net Income GAAP 1 Week % Change
GAAP net.documentation: Percent change in the specified period GAAP net income estimate within the week prior to today's date. Available for Standard, Re-Set and 4 Week consensus only.

GAAP net.description: BEst Net Income GAAP 4 Week % Change
GAAP net.documentation: Percent change in the specified period GAAP net income estimate within the four weeks prior to today's date. Available for Standard, Re-Set and 4 Week consensus only.
The change in the specified period GAAP Net Income estimate within the week prior to today's date. Not a percent change.  Available for Consensus only: Standard, Re-Set and 4 week
The change in the specified period  GAAP net income estimate over the last 4 weeks. Not a percent change.  Available for Consensus only: Standard, Re-Set and 4 week

The percent change in the GAAP Net Income for the specified period versus the same period a year earlier. The comparable GAAP Net Income is used for historical periods. If no comparable value is available, the value will not be calculated. This field uses estimated values when both periods are in the future. Available for Broker estimates and Consensus: Standard, Re-Set Consensus, and 4 Week.

The change in the specified period GAAP Net Income estimate over the prior GAAP Net Income estimate. Not a percent change.  Only available for broker estimates.  Available for Broker Estimates, Standard Consensus, Re-Set Consensus, and 4 Week Consensus.

The percentage change in the specified period GAAP Net Income estimate over the prior GAAP Net Income estimate.  Available for Broker Estimates, Standard Consensus, Re-Set Consensus, and 4 Week Consensus.
The number of analysts increasing their GAAP Net Income estimates within the 4 weeks prior to the latest consensus date. Available for Consensus only: Standard, Re-Set and 4 week
The number of analysts decreasing their GAAP Net Income estimates within the 4 weeks prior to the latest consensus date. Available for Consensus only: Standard, Re-Set and 4 week

The percent change in the GAAP Net Income estimate for the specified period from the same period a quarter earlier. Available for Broker estimates and Consensus: Standard, Re-Set Consensus, and 4 Week
A statistical measure of dispersion of the contributed GAAP Net Income estimates around their mean value for the specified period.  Only available for broker estimates.

GAAP net.description: BEst Net Inc GAAP Actual Change
GAAP net.documentation: Actual change, excluding reiteration in the specified period GAAP net income estimate over the prior GAAP net income estimate. Not a percent change. Only available for broker estimates.

GAAP net.description: BEst Net Inc GAAP Actual % Change
GAAP net.documentation: Actual percentage change, excluding reiteration in the specified period GAAP net income estimate over the prior GAAP net income estimate.  Only available for broker estimates.
